description: This source file implements the Redis-based grain directory for Orleans, providing methods for lookup, registration, and unregistration of grain addresses, as well as lifecycle management with Redis connection handling and logging.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implements the Orleans grain directory using Redis for distributed location storage, supporting lookup, registration, and lifecycle operations.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the address of a specified grain from Redis.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in Redis, with optional previous address for conflict resolution.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from Redis if it matches the current activation ID.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Method placeholder for silos unregistration logic, currently a no-op.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the grain directory to lifecycle events to handle initialization and uninitialization.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Establishes Redis connection and sets up event handlers for connection issues.

methods.name: Uninitialize
methods.description: Closes Redis connection and cleans up resources during shutdown.
